SH-12.word.receipt.meaning: What sits behind every number: the rows, the period, the definitions, what was left out and how much was counted.
SH-12.word.source.meaning: A place your data comes from, such as Tally, a bank file or a spreadsheet.
SH-12.word.meaning.meaning: What one of your business words stands for, such as sales or a customer. Written once, used everywhere.
SH-12.word.recipe.meaning: How one system's fields become your business words.
SH-12.word.approval.meaning: Your yes to exactly one prepared change. Nothing that changes things runs without it.
SH-12.word.send-level.meaning: How much may go to an AI model: nothing, the shape only, or samples.
SH-12.word.route.meaning: One way of reaching an AI model: your own tool, an API key, or a local model.
SH-12.word.seat.meaning: One person's way into a workspace, with what that person may do.
SH-12.word.pen.meaning: The right to write. One computer holds it at a time; the others read.
SH-12.word.demo-clock.meaning: A pretend date in a demo workspace. It only moves forward, and a real workspace never has one.
SH-12.word.sheet.meaning: The panel at the right that shows the detail of the row you opened.
SH-12.word.banner.meaning: A strip above the page for a condition that affects the whole app.
SH-12.word.view.meaning: One of three ways the same app is shown: Simple, Guided, Books.
SH-12.word.square.meaning: A small mark that says who did something and whose turn it is.
SH-12.word.coverage.meaning: The line that says how many rows were counted and left out, and what is not loaded yet.
SH-12.word.marking.meaning: A label such as personal, financial or confidential, put on a file or a field. It follows the data everywhere.
SH-12.word.starter-pack.meaning: Ready-made meanings for one kind of business.
